build_BCAgent: build a behavior cloning agent with an Actor network and Adam optimizer for offline RL training
create_Actor_network: create a neural network policy that maps observations to truncated normal action distributions
run_BCAgent_act: run the BCAgent act method to sample actions from the policy given an observation and step
test_BCAgent_update: test the BCAgent update method by passing a replay buffer iterator and training step number
review_BCAgent_update_actor: review the BCAgent update_actor method that computes log probability loss and performs backpropagation
